legend: A team of divers is surveying the cargo of the Zenobia, a shipwreck off the coast of Larnaca. In one section of its cargo deck, rectangular containers completely cover an $$$n \times m$$$ grid. Each container occupies exactly two cells sharing a side, and each cell belongs to exactly one container.
The boundaries between the containers are hidden by sediment. The divers can inspect individual cells to identify the containers. Each inspection takes time, so the number of inspections is limited.

Rows are numbered from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$ from top to bottom, and columns from $$$1$$$ to $$$m$$$ from left to right. You can inspect a cell $$$(x,y)$$$. The reply describes which half of its container occupies the cell:
U: the upper half of a vertical container; its other half is at $$$(x+1,y)$$$;
D: the lower half of a vertical container; its other half is at $$$(x-1,y)$$$;
L: the left half of a horizontal container; its other half is at $$$(x,y+1)$$$;
R: the right half of a horizontal container; its other half is at $$$(x,y-1)$$$.
Reconstruct the arrangement of all containers using at most $$$\lfloor nm/4\rfloor$$$ queries. The arrangement is fixed before the interaction starts and does not change in response to your queries.
First you need to read two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$m$$$ ($$$1 \le n,m \le 100$$$), the number of rows and columns. It is guaranteed that $$$nm$$$ is even.

To inspect a cell, print a line of the form ? x y, where $$$1 \le x \le n$$$ and $$$1 \le y \le m$$$. The interactor replies with one of U, D, L, or R on a separate line. Repeated queries are allowed, but each counts toward the limit.

When you have reconstructed the tiling, print a line containing !, followed by $$$n$$$ lines of $$$m$$$ characters each. Character $$$y$$$ of line $$$x$$$ must be the half occupying cell $$$(x,y)$$$, using the same U, D, L, and R notation. Your answer must match the hidden tiling exactly. Printing the final answer does not count as a query. Then terminate your program.
After printing each query and after printing the final answer, flush the output buffer. For example, use cout.flush() in C++ or sys.stdout.flush() in Python.
If you make an invalid query or exceed the query limit, your solution will be judged incorrect. If you read -1 or reach the end of input while expecting a reply, terminate immediately.

legend.ai: 一支潜水队正在调查沉船 Zenobia 的货物。该船沉没在拉纳卡海岸附近。在货舱甲板的一个区域，矩形集装箱完全覆盖了一个 $$$n \times m$$$ 网格。每个集装箱恰好占据两个共边的单元格，且每个单元格恰好属于一个集装箱。
容器之间的边界被沉积物掩盖了。潜水员可以检查单个单元格，以确定容器的位置。每次检查都需要时间，因此检查次数是有限的。
行号从上到下依次为 $$$1$$$ 至 $$$n$$$，列号从左到右依次为 $$$1$$$ 至 $$$m$$$。你可以查询一个单元格 $$$(x,y)$$$。回复会描述其所在容器的哪一半占据了该单元格：
U：垂直容器的上半部分；其另一半位于 $$$(x+1,y)$$$；
D：垂直容器的下半部分；另一半位于 $$$(x-1,y)$$$；
L：水平容器的左半部分；另一半位于 $$$(x,y+1)$$$；
R：一个水平容器的右半部分；另一半位于 $$$(x,y-1)$$$。
使用至多 $$$\lfloor nm/4\rfloor$$$ 次询问还原所有容器的排列。该排列在交互开始前已固定，并且不会因你的询问而改变。
首先，你需要读入两个整数 $$$n$$$ 和 $$$m$$$($$$1 \le n,m \le 100$$$)，分别表示行数和列数。保证 $$$nm$$$ 为偶数。
要检查一个单元格，请输出一行 ? x y，其中 $$$1 \le x \le n$$$ 且 $$$1 \le y \le m$$$。交互器会在单独一行回复 U、D、L 或 R 之一。允许重复查询，但每次查询都会计入限制。
当你重建出铺砖方案后，输出一行包含 !，随后输出 $$$n$$$ 行，每行包含 $$$m$$$ 个字符。第 $$$x$$$ 行的第 $$$y$$$ 个字符必须表示占据单元格 $$$(x,y)$$$ 的半格，并使用相同的 U、D、L 和 R 表示法。你的答案必须与隐藏的铺砖方案完全一致。输出最终答案不计为一次询问。然后终止程序。
在输出每次询问以及最终答案后，请刷新输出缓冲区。例如，在 C++ 中使用 cout.flush()，在 Python 中使用 sys.stdout.flush()。
如果你进行无效查询或超出查询次数限制，你的解法将被判定为错误。如果读取到 -1，或在等待回复时到达输入末尾，请立即终止。
